text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—Now, the mock race has entered the final phase! Still leading the pack is Tap Dance City! Showing an awe-inspiring runaway lead right from the start!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City enters the final stretch!
Kicking into an even higher gear,
she leaves the chasers drowning in her wake--!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Amazing, Tap!
She really led wire-to-wire all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Woo-hoooo!!! We won, Trainer!
How about that! You felt the romance, didn't you!?"
choice_data_list: Yeah! That was a great run!
Yeah! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Tap.
You've gotten way better at pacing yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ace...!!
You were watching! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
More than just a good feeling,
I've started catching a real good wave!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Your aura reached all the way to the stands.
Everyone's eyes were glued to your running!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That was a passionate, incredible run.
I can't afford to slack off either!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: I'm so glad, Tap Dance City!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But I'm not just happy
because Ace praised me—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"More than that, I'm just so happy
to feel that our course is the right one!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The course you charted really is great!
I'll leave the helm to you from now on too, Navigator!!
